description:
Title: Farming Bot

Players want to create custom farming bots, that help them gather resources.
First you have to find out which resources you want.
Up to 10 resources in parallel can be collected, some resources are more urgently needed than others.
Some resources are required to create tools that are needed to gather other resources (create a custom logic of the dependencies in your game).
After all preferences are collected, your bot starts farming.
Sometimes,  random natural disasters strike and set your bot back.
Whenever some milestones are reached, you are notified.
During farming it is possible to update the list of to be farmed materials (at all times).
After the bot is finished, you should be able to brag to selected friends and/or send them materials.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FarmingBot" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/farming-bot">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_UpdateList" name="Material list update requested"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Milestone" name="Milestone reached"/>
  <bpmn:signal id="Signal_Disaster" name="Natural disaster strikes"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_FarmingBot" name="Farming Bot" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Creation" name="Bot creation started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Prefs" name="Preferences merge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrefsLoop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectResources" name="Select resources to farm">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SetUrgency" name="Set urgency per resource">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="Task_ResolveDependencies" name="Resolve tool dependencies between resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrefsComplete" name="All preferences collected?" default="Flow_Ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrefsLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Farming" name="Farm resources">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AfterFarm</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Farm" name="Farming started">
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge_Farm" name="Farming merge">
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_1</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_NotDone</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_2</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectResources" name="Collect selected resources (max. 10 in parallel)">
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_2</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_Milestone" name="Milestone reached">
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_3</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_4</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Milestone" signalRef="Signal_Milestone"/>
      </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyMilestone" name="Notify player of milestone">
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_4</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FarmDone" name="Bot finished?" default="SF_NotDone">
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_5</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_Done</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>SF_NotDone</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Farm" name="Farming finished">
        <bpmn:incoming>SF_Done</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:subProcess id="Sub_Disaster" name="Natural disaster setback" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Disaster" name="Natural disaster" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>DIS_1</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:signalEventDefinition id="SignalDef_Disaster" signalRef="Signal_Disaster"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:task id="Task_ApplySetback" name="Set bot back">
          <bpmn:incoming>DIS_1</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>DIS_2</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:task>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Disaster" name="Setback applied">
          <bpmn:incoming>DIS_2</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="DIS_1" sourceRef="Start_Disaster" targetRef="Task_ApplySetback"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="DIS_2" sourceRef="Task_ApplySetback" targetRef="End_Disaster"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:subProcess id="Sub_UpdateList" name="Update material list" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_UpdateList" name="Update requested" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>UPD_1</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_UpdateList" messageRef="Msg_UpdateList"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:userTask id="Task_UpdateList" name="Update list of materials to farm">
          <bpmn:incoming>UPD_1</bpmn:incoming>
          <bpmn:outgoing>UPD_2</bpmn:outgoing>
        </bpmn:userTask>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="End_UpdateList" name="List updated">
          <bpmn:incoming>UPD_2</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="UPD_1" sourceRef="Start_UpdateList" targetRef="Task_UpdateList"/>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="UPD_2" sourceRef="Task_UpdateList" targetRef="End_UpdateList"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_1" sourceRef="Start_Farm" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Farm"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_2" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Farm" targetRef="Task_CollectResources"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_3" sourceRef="Task_CollectResources" targetRef="Event_Milestone"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_4" sourceRef="Event_Milestone" targetRef="Task_NotifyMilestone"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_5" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMilestone" targetRef="Gateway_FarmDone"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_Done" name="Bot finished" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmDone" targetRef="End_Farm">
        <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${farmingFinished}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_NotDone" name="Not finished" sourceRef="Gateway_FarmDone" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Farm"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AfterFarm_Split" name="Brag and/or send materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AfterFarm</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Brag</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendMat</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Brag" name="Brag to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Brag</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BragJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendMaterials" name="Send materials to selected friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendMat</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AfterFarm_Join" name="Friend actions done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BragJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Final" name="Bot cycle completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Creation" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Prefs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge_Prefs" targetRef="Task_SelectResources"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectResources" targetRef="Task_SetUrgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SetUrgency" targetRef="Task_ResolveDependencies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ResolveDependencies" targetRef="Gateway_PrefsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrefsLoop" name="Not all collected" sourceRef="Gateway_PrefsComplete" targetRef="Gateway_Merge_Prefs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${!preferencesComplete}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready" name="All collected" sourceRef="Gateway_PrefsComplete" targetRef="SubProcess_Farming"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AfterFarm" sourceRef="SubProcess_Farming" targetRef="Gateway_AfterFarm_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Brag" name="Brag" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterFarm_Split" targetRef="Task_Brag"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendMat" name="Send materials" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterFarm_Split" targetRef="Task_SendMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BragJoin" sourceRef="Task_Brag" targetRef="Gateway_AfterFarm_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendJoin" sourceRef="Task_SendMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_AfterFarm_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterFarm_Join" targetRef="End_Final"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
